title: MZ Trying to use MV plugins work in MZ

posts.author: Kretyn
posts.body:

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
I'll let Aqua handle you since this is her jam. Just to address a few points:
Kretyn said:
However, there is no mention of `fontSize` here.
Click to expand...
It's from FOSSIL. Damage popups are made differently in MZ, they don't use a spritesheet, so there is no digitWidth() method. Line 4430 of FOSSIL calculates the digit width based on the size of the selected font.
Sprite_Damage.fontSize()
is
a default part of MZ, so getting errors that it's not a function implies to me you might have a plugin conflict or some JavaScript notetags/plugin parameters with typos.
Make sure you're testing this with
only
the plugins you need enabled.
Kretyn said:
Where does the 63 come from?  What is baseRow?
Click to expand...
baseRow is the name of the first argument being passed into the function.
This function will require more rewriting to be compatible with MZ. As I said, MZ no longer pulls the popup numbers from a spritesheet, and that's what baseRow and the derived variable row inside the function are doing.
You'd need to compare this function to the createDigits() method in MZ's code and splice them together to create sprites the way MZ expects but add the zooming or whatever this plugin adds. That's why you're getting
value
is undefined, because everything in MZ is passing only one number into createDigits() where MV passed two. (the varying numbers you're seeing for
baseRow
is the damage being done)
Note that this plugin is essentially unrelated to the tutorial you linked to above. That only went through the Chrono Engine.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
It also depends on what the OP is trying to do.
If it's the on-the-map-turn-based-with-positioning like Chrono Trigger, it honestly would be easier to pick up MV with the Steam summer sale discount and use that.
But if they're going for the ABS functionality, there are a number of other plugins written natively for MZ to do that.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body: There are people here who have Chrono Engine ABS mode working fine with MZ since Restart made them compatible. It's just the Chrono mode specifically that's not compatible since Restart never used that mode. Same reason his Cross Engine doesn't work with Chrono mode.
